timing: categories selected after meaning, controls and primary artistic comparison; before baseline drafting

selected.derivation: The requester asks each arm to choose a random complex concept for an actual image test; a concurrent visible situation is the narrow common realization. The ferry setting itself is agent-owned.
selected.reason: A layered situation rather than a catalog-style arrangement makes relations testable in a complete photograph.

selected.derivation: The requester asks to use the attached image. Directly observed face and hair guide the main person while clothing, body and biography remain independently authored.
selected.reason: A recognizable reference-guided presence must remain available while the scene is inhabited.
A small coastal waiting room offers bench-height work and a visible boarding gate for the selected ferry situation.
Hand-to-buckle contact provides a concrete cause and a visible next state.
The second passenger steadies the suitcase so the action has an understandable shared purpose.
Distinct garment boundaries and material surfaces distinguish worn layers from separate accessories in the moving situation.
The suitcase webbing, fastening and owner give the action physical endpoints instead of an isolated pose.
Wet umbrellas and the opening gate connect a previous rain delay with departure becoming possible.
The window-cool room and warm face form a quiet attention hierarchy beyond the garment color labels.
